Role.title: Role
Role.description: Defines the different access levels and responsibilities for users within the SmartRest AI system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Role entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the role's permissions and responsibilities.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a staff member of the restaurant with an assigned role.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for login and identification.

roleId.description: Reference to the Role entity, indicating the user's assigned role.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the user account is currently active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

Ingredient.title: Ingredient
Ingredient.description: Represents a raw material or stock item used in a specific branch.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Ingredient entity.

branchId.description: Reference to the branch this ingredient belongs to.

averageDailyConsumption.description: Estimated average daily consumption for IA predictions.

minStockLevel.description: The minimum stock level for alerts.

definition.description: Tracks raw ingredients for inventory management per branch.

firestore.reasoning: Se migra el inventario a Firestore con branchId para permitir gestión independiente por sucursal.
